### Architecture
repo is a high-performance audio processing framework that ingests raw audio configuration files and stream definitions, executes real-time signal mixing and spatialization via a core engine, and outputs synchronized audio buffers for playback or inspection. The system leverages a modular architecture to decouple domain-specific audio logic from infrastructure-level controllers, ensuring low-latency state management and telemetry-driven performance monitoring. **Key Architectural Patterns:**
